title: Do not waste the rare chance of a human life
summary: This meets the sleepy assumption that there will always be more time. The line treats human birth as rare fortune, not a casual repeatable resource.
lifeApplication: Before another numbing loop of scrolling, snacking, or drifting, sit upright and say the line once. Let rarity bring the day into focus.

source.shortMeaning: Human life is rare enough to demand deliberate use.
source.lifeApplication: When the day goes dull, remember how rare this chance already is.

evidence.coreClaim: Human life is rare enough to demand deliberate use.
evidence.turn: Treat this life as rare enough to center it on Naam.
